# wso2is_secret (Resource)

Stores a secret for adaptive authentication scripts. Scripts read the secret as `secrets.<name>`, for example in `httpGet` or `httpPost` calls. The server never returns the value, so the provider cannot notice changes made outside Terraform. To import, use the ID `<type>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_secret" "risk_api_key" {
  name             = "risk_api_key"
  value_wo         = var.risk_api_key # Terraform 1.11+: never stored in state
  value_wo_version = 1
  description      = "Used by adaptive scripts as secrets.risk_api_key"
}

variable "risk_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name (letters, digits and underscores). Changing it replaces the secret.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Description.
- `type` (String) Secret type. The default is `ADAPTIVE_AUTH_CALL_CHOREO`, the type adaptive scripts read.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value. Terraform stores it in the state. Use `value_wo` instead to keep it out of the state.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret value (Terraform 1.11+). Change `value_wo_version` to update it.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Increase this number to send a new `value_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<type>/<name>`.
- `secret_id` (String) Server-side secret ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_secret.risk_api_key ADAPTIVE_AUTH_CALL_CHOREO/risk_api_key
```
